bHERALDRY

A symbol is evidence, not artwork. These records carry a symbol's meaning, grammar, sources, uses and translations as separate, typed claims — the four truths: source authenticity, historical interpretation, language equivalence, authority.

Read-only. The data is bheraldry-records.json, generated from crates/bheraldry and digest-pinned to the code.

Standing boundary

A research and conformance specimen. Not government endorsement. Not reproduction rights: reproducing elements of the Bulgarian arms requires an act of the Council of Ministers (Чл. 3 (2)). Unofficial translations are visibly marked machine drafts (⚙, unattested). No living person is named — living subjects are pseudonyms by law.

External links (lex.bg, government.bg, Wikipedia, dv.parliament.bg) open in a new tab; same-estate pages stay in this one. Record digests are sha256(bheraldry/record/1 ‖ canonical bytes) — verify before trusting. Integrity of these renderings lives in the crate's tests, not in this page's paint.
